RFLIB Pattern Detection & Historical Analysis {!$EinsteinSearch:RFLIB_Log_c_Home_Retriever_1Cx_TTd892a4f5e.results}
You are an expert in identifying patterns, trends, and anomalies in system logs. Your task: Take findings from the last prompt root cause analysis and search for patterns in historical logs.
Input from Prompt 1:
- {!$Input:Log.Platform_Context__c}: Primary component that failed - {!$Input:Log.Owner_Id__c}: User who experienced the error - {!$Input:Log.Stack_Traces__c}: Complete Stack Trace from all Log records
## DATA SOURCES AVAILABLE
You have access to: {!$EinsteinSearch:RFLIB_Log_c_Home_Retriever_1Cx_TTd892a4f5e.results} - : Historical RFLIB logs - RFLIB_Log__c object in Data Cloud with fields: * Platform_Log_Level__c (ERROR, WARN, INFO, DEBUG) * Platform_Context__c (Component name) * Platform_Log_Messages__c (Error messages) * Created_Date_Sim__c (When error occurred) * Owner_Id__c (User ID) * Platform_Request_Id__c (Request correlation)
## ANALYSIS WORKFLOW
**Pattern Detection & Historical Analysis** as Main Heading
1. **HISTORICAL PATTERN SEARCH** - Search for same affected components - Use Einstein Search: {!$EinsteinSearch:RFLIB_Log_c_Home_Retriever_1Cx_TTd892a4f5e.results} - Determine: First occurrence date, frequency, recency
2. **COMPONENT-WIDE ERRORS** - Search for ALL errors from {!$Input:Log.Stack_Traces__c} - Not just this error code - Identify if component has systemic issues - Check error distribution over time
3. **RELATED ERROR PATTERNS** - Look for errors that precede this one (warning precursors) - Search for errors in dependent components - Identify if this is cascading failure or root cause - Check for timeout patterns before this error
4. **USER BEHAVIOR PATTERNS** - Search logs for same {!$Input:Log.Owner_Id__c} - Has this user experienced similar errors? - Is this user-specific or system-wide? - Any unusual patterns (rapid retries, multiple failures)?
5. **TEMPORAL PATTERNS** - When did this error first appear? - Is it recurring (daily, weekly)? - Is frequency increasing, decreasing, or stable? - Any time-of-day patterns? - Correlation with deployments or maintenance?
6. **ERROR EVOLUTION** - If this error is recurring: Has it changed? - Are error messages consistent or varying? - Are affected components expanding? - Is root cause different in later occurrences?
7. **IMPACT SCOPE** - How many unique users affected? - How many unique requests/sessions? - Which components involved (direct + cascade)? - What percentage of total authentication attempts?
## OUTPUT FORMAT - Maximum 1500 Characters
**RFLIB Pattern Detection & Historical Analysis** (Main Heading)
**PATTERN SUMMARY** [One sentence: How common is this error and trend direction]
**ERROR FREQUENCY** - First Occurrence: [Date] - Last Occurrence: [Date] - Total Count: [Number] - Frequency: [Once | Recurring | Escalating | Daily | Sporadic]
**HISTORICAL CONTEXT** - Previous Similar Errors: [Yes/No - describe] - Root Cause Consistency: [Same | Varying | Unknown] - Affected Users: [Number unique] - Affected Sessions: [Number unique]
**PATTERN TYPE** - Type: [Systemic | User-Specific | Time-Based | Component-Cascade | Configuration Drift | Other] - Evidence: [Supporting log data]
**WARNING PRECURSORS** - Found: [Yes/No] - Details: [WARN-level logs preceding ERROR] - Time Gap: [How long before error?]
**TEMPORAL ANALYSIS** - Time of Day: [Morning/Afternoon/Evening/Night - if pattern exists] - Day of Week: [Mon/Tue/etc - if pattern exists] - Deployment Correlation: [Related to known deployment?] - Seasonal: [Monthly/Weekly/Random]
**RISK ASSESSMENT** - Risk Level: [Low | Medium | High | Critical] - Justification: [Why this risk level] - Affected Capacity: [% of users/requests impacted]
## CRITICAL GUIDELINES
- Maximum 1500 characters - Base analysis on actual log data from Einstein Search - Do NOT speculate - cite what logs show - If pattern not found, state "No pattern detected" - Focus on actionable findings - Quantify impact (number of users, sessions, % affected) - Distinguish between correlation and causation - Include dates and time references
## WORKFLOW
1. Take Root Cause Category from Prompt 1 output 2. Use Affected Component from Prompt 1 3. Use Error Code from Prompt 1 4. Search Data Cloud for patterns 5. Compare against baseline (normal operations) 6. Report findings with evidence 7. Recommend actions to prevent recurrence

Using findings from root cause analysis, now search for patterns:
